depiction.primary_object: front half of a car and front of a bicycle
depiction.composition: two partial vehicles in side profile facing right, overlapping diagonally

readings.meaning: multimodal commute or transportation options (car and bike)
sharing the road between drivers and cyclists

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the overlapping lines and two differently sized wheels can look like a single strange tractor, wheelchair, or broken vehicle.
task_intents: compare driving versus biking commute times
manage household car and bike storage
handle car and bicycle accident claim
install bicycle rack on the car

log work commute miles by mode

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts the front of a car alongside the front of a bicycle. It fits tasks that specifically involve both vehicles together—such as comparing driving vs. cycling commutes, mounting a bike rack on a car, sharing the road, or organizing garage space for both—though single-vehicle tasks are much better served by a plain car or plain bicycle icon.
